evidence_added: RULER.md: statistic (episode = unit; majority action after the last interrupt), alpha 1/100, n 2048 per arm (balanced r), bound 1/2, delta 1/20, integer thresholds k_pos 1078 / k_neg 1073, INDETERMINATE band, exact size and power table, P-CAL rule, field decisions
P-RET: NOT_SHOWN (wrong >= 1078) / POSITIVE (correct >= 1078) / NEGATIVE (correct <= 1073) / INDETERMINATE; a RULER, never PASS/FAIL (C1)
P-CAL: PASS iff NULL and SHUF correct <= 1073 and POS POSITIVE; FAIL names the first failing arm; never passes by default

operating characteristics (exact): P(POSITIVE | p = 1/2) = 0.0090 <= alpha; P(NEGATIVE | 1/2) = 0.9766; P(POSITIVE | 11/20) = 0.9850; P(NEGATIVE | 11/20) = 0.0095 <= alpha; P-CAL arm pass at 1/2 = 0.9857
design finding before freeze: n = 640 is underpowered (NEGATIVE 0.57, INDETERMINATE 0.41 under no carry; P-CAL arm mostly fails) -> n = 2048
design finding before freeze: counting abstention as incorrect would let an abstaining no-carry subject read NOT_SHOWN; NOT_SHOWN is decided on wrong answers (FD-T014-2)
